inspiration.observed_pattern: An INSERT computes a value from a membership predicate over a grouped derived table naturally joined to another read of the same target table.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Use independently authored signal-marker rows and insert one derived marker whose integer flag is calculated by an IN predicate over a grouped signal-code relation NATURAL JOINed to the existing target projection.

fixture_notes: Existing signal codes 10 and 20 are reduced to distinct grouped values before the natural join; the inserted marker records whether code 20 was present and leaves the original markers unchanged.
determinism_notes: Fixed marker IDs, signal codes, derived membership value, and final ordering are used. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE signal_markers (marker_id INT PRIMARY KEY, signal_code INT NOT NULL, marker_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO signal_markers (marker_id, signal_code, marker_label) VALUES (4, (20 IN (SELECT signal_code FROM (SELECT signal_code FROM signal_markers GROUP BY signal_code) AS grouped_codes NATURAL JOIN (SELECT signal_code FROM signal_markers) AS observed_codes)), 'derived-membership')

checks.sql: SELECT marker_id, signal_code, marker_label FROM signal_markers ORDER BY marker_id
